name: repospec
description: Deterministic canonical RepoSpec IR (OpenAPI for architecture, tests, CI, IaC, governance, and code-quality rules) with SQLite graph index and interactive visual studio.

scripts.lint:privacy: bun -e 'const r = Bun.spawnSync(["git", "grep", "-nE", "(/Users/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+|C:\\\\Users\\\\[A-Za-z0-9._-]+|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})", "--", "src", "tests", "rules", "config", "skills", "README.md", ":!tests/fixtures/"]); const out = r.stdout.toString().trim(); if (out) { console.error("Privacy audit failed:\n" + out); process.exit(1); }'
scripts.lint:ts-only: bun -e 'import { Glob } from "bun"; const bad = [...new Glob("{src,tests}/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs,jsx}").scanSync(".")]; if (bad.length > 0) { console.error("Non-TypeScript files found:\n" + bad.join("\n")); process.exit(1); }'
scripts.check:vstack: bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:privacy && bun run lint:ts-only && bun run lint:no-comments && bun run lint:state-machines && bun run lint:laws && bun run lint:formal-sync && bun run lint:bench && bun run perf:check && bunx vstack scan . --strict && bunx vstack doctor . --fail
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run check:vstack
